questions.question:
From the given words, select the word which cannot be formed using the letters of the given word.

LATCHING
questions.solution:
1) THING → LA**T**C**HING** → can be formed.

2) CHAIN → L**A**T**CHIN**G → can be formed.

3) CHEAT → LATCHING → cannot be formed as there is no E.

4) CLING → **L**AT**C**H**ING** → can be formed.

Hence, the word ‘CHEAT’ cannot be formed due to the absence of alphabet ‘E’ in the word ‘LATCHING’.

questions.question:
A series is given, with one term missing. Choose the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

CDE, IHG, KLM, QPO, STU, ?
questions.solution:
A group of three letters in alphabetical order followed by absence of one alphabet, then the next three letters in reverse order followed by absence of one alphabet then the next three letters in alphabetical order and so on.

CDE (in alphabetical order), (absence of F),

IHG (in reverse order), (absence of J),

KLM (in alphabetical order), (absence of N),

QPO (in reverse order), (absence of R),

STU (in alphabetical order), (absence of V),

So, now the answer will be in reverse order i.e. YXW

Thus, YXW is the correct answer.

questions.question: The weights of 4 boxes are 90, 40, 80 and 50 kilograms. Which of the following cannot be the total weight, in kilograms, of any combination of these boxes and in a combination a box can be used only once?
questions.solution:
The weight of 4 boxes are 90, 40, 80 and 50 kilograms.

1) 200 = cannot be the total weight.

2) 260 = 90 + 40 + 80 + 50

3) 180 = 90 + 40 + 50

4) 170 = 90 + 80

Thus, 200 is the correct answer.

questions.question: A plane flies 100 km West, then it turns South and flies 150 km, then it turns West and flies 300 km, then it turns to its right and flies 150 km. Where is it now with reference to its starting position?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f5e06737be0d9c26e1df07b79b0b053547c39c14148b12fca4c9490621047cc.png] 

Assuming ‘L’ as the starting position and ‘P’ as the ending position.

ON = 300 km.

ON = PM = 300 km.

LM = 100 km.

Thus, PL = PM + ML

= 300 + 100

= 400 km.

Thus, the plane is 400 km west with reference to its starting position.

questions.question: Arnav's birthday is on Tuesday 14th March. On what day of the week will be Pranay's Birthday in the same year if Pranay was born on 13th September?
questions.solution:
Arnav’s birthday = 14th March, Tuesday

Pranay’s birthday = 13th September

Days between 14th March - 13th September =

→ 17 (March) + 30 (April) + 31 (May) + 30 (June)+ 31 (July) + 31 (August) + 13 (September)

→ 183 days = 183/7 → 1 odd day

→ Wednesday

Hence, Pranay’s birthday will be on Wednesday.
